chapter.v:
“Call if
you want, but who is going to answer you? Which angel are you going to turn to?

Surely anger
slays the fool and jealousy kills the simple.

I have
seen a fool growing strong, but I immediately cursed his house.

His sons
are never safe; they are crushed in court with no one to defend them.

The hungry
eat everything he has harvested, taking even that protected by a thorn hedge, while others look to steal his wealth.

For evil
doesn't come from the dust; neither does trouble grow from the earth.

But human
beings are born for trouble just as certainly as sparks from a fire fly upwards.

If it
were me, I would go to God and put my case before him.

He is
the one who does amazing, incredible things; miracles that can't be counted!

He gives
rain to the earth and sends water to the fields.

He exalts
the humble, and rescues those who mourn.

He frustrates
the plans of the cunning so that they are unsuccessful.

He traps
the wise in their own clever thinking, and the schemes of twisted people are cut short.

In the
daytime they're in the dark, and they stumble around at noon like it's night.

But God
is the one who saves from their cutting remarks, and the poor from the actions of the powerful.

As a
result those who are helpless have hope, and the wicked have to shut their mouths!

See how
happy is the person God corrects—so don't despise the Almighty's discipline.

For he
causes pain but he provides relief; he wounds but his hands heal.

He will
save you from many disasters; a multitude of evils will not affect you.

In times
of famine he will rescue you from death, and in times of war he will save you from the power of the sword.

You will
be protected from sharp-tongued slander; and when violence comes you will not be afraid.

You will
laugh at violence and famine; you won't be afraid of wild animals—

for you
will be at peace with the stones of the field and the wild animals will be at peace with you.

You will
be certain that your home is safe, for you will go to where you live and find nothing missing.

You will
also be sure that you will have many children; your descendants will be like the grass of the earth.

You will
live to a ripe old age like a sheaf of grain when it is harvested.

Look, we've
examined it, and it's true! Listen to what I'm saying and apply it to yourself!”
